routing.offNotice: OpenDesign keys also join the shared pool of every model with the same bare name. To reach OpenDesign only through the prefix, set this in the CPA config (it applies to every credential with a prefix):
routing.help1: The prefix is the auth file's standard prefix field. CPA adds it to the registered model names and strips it before forwarding, so OpenDesign still receives the bare model ID.

signin.sub: Sign an account in on “{name}” to read its official 5-hour and 7-day allowance. Its keys stay in CPA's auth file and never reach the browser.
